title: LLM-Only PDDL Domain Repair with Open-Weight Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.17341v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI planning is concerned with finding a sequence of actions that achieves a specified goal. It relies on explicit models of the world, commonly represented in the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL). An active line of research investigates how errors in such models can be detected and repaired. For example, users may provide positive test plans that are solutions, and negative test plans that fail during execution. Automated repair methods then modify the PDDL model to satisfy these constraints. In this paper, we evaluate the ability of recent open-weight large language models to perform this repair task using an LLM-only approach. Our experiments show that the symbolic baseline achieves an $F_1$ score of $.49$, while the best-performing LLM reaches $.87$ with high reasoning effort, an absolute improvement of $.38$. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17341v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人工智能规划关注的是找到一系列实现特定目标的行动序列。它依赖于明确的世界模型，通常用规划领域定义语言（PDDL）表示。一个活跃的研究方向是调查此类模型中的错误如何被检测和修复。例如，用户可能提供作为解决方案的正测试计划和在执行过程中失败的负测试计划。自动修复方法随后修改PDDL模型以满足这些约束。在本文中，我们评估了近期开放权重大型语言模型使用仅大语言模型方法执行此修复任务的能力。我们的实验表明，符号基线方法的$F_1$得分为$.49$，而表现最佳的LLM在高推理努力下达到$.87$，绝对提升为$.38$。然而，该设置的平均测试通过率仅为$.82$，在Thoughtful领域降至$.06$；即使是最佳模型也...
tldr: 本文评估了开放权重大型语言模型仅用LLM方法修复PDDL领域错误的能力，最佳模型显著优于符号基线，但在特定领域仍存在可靠性挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates open-weight LLMs for PDDL domain repair using an LLM-only approach, where the best model significantly outperforms the symbolic baseline but still faces reliability challenges in certain domains.
